summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the start of drilling at its Trap target in Colombia after receiving a key exploration title from the Colombian National Mining Agency and acquiring a 100% interest in an outstanding tenement for US$3.5 million payable in three equal installments. The drilling, set for May 2026, will test a 1,400-meter vein corridor and a new gold-copper porphyry anomaly. This is a routine operational update on exploration progress, not a special situation involving M&A, activist campaigns, or other corporate events.
